name: Spotlight
description:
A compact macOS Spotlight-inspired launcher for GNOME Shell. Press a shortcut, type, and results appear instantly - apps and files ranked by match quality and usage, an inline calculator that copies results to the clipboard, system actions like lock and suspend, GNOME Settings panels, and a web search fallback when nothing else matches.

Open with Ctrl+Space (configurable in preferences). Click outside or press Esc to close.
